```{r}
model <- function(t, state, parms) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parms)), {

    # Functional responses
    f1a <- mu1a_max * Ra / (K1a + Ra)
    f1b <- mu1b_max * Rb / (K1b + Rb)
    f2a <- mu2a_max * Ra / (K2a + Ra)
    f2b <- mu2b_max * Rb / (K2b + Rb)

    # Population dynamics
    dC1 <- C1 * ((1 - l1a) * f1a + (1 - l1b) * f1b - sigma1 + theta1)
    dC2 <- C2 * ((1 - l2a) * f2a + (1 - l2b) * f2b - sigma2 + theta2)

    # Resource dynamics
    # resource a is consumed by both consumers on resource a
    # resource b is consumed by both consumers on resource b
    dRa <- C1 * (l1a * f1a + l1b * f1b) -
      (C1 * mu1a_max * Ra / (K1a + Ra) +
       C2 * mu2a_max * Ra / (K2a + Ra))

    dRb <- C1 * (l2a * f2a + l2b * f2b) -
      (C1 * mu1b_max * Rb / (K1b + Rb) +
       C2 * mu2b_max * Rb / (K2b + Rb))

    list(c(dC1, dC2, dRa, dRb))
  })
}

## Example parameter values (replace with yours)
parms <- c(
  l1a = 0.2, l1b = 0.3,
  l2a = 0.2, l2b = 0.3,

  mu1a_max = 1.0, mu1b_max = 0.9,
  mu2a_max = 1.0, mu2b_max = .9,

  K1a = 0.5, K1b = 0.6,
  K2a = 0.4, K2b = 0.7,

  sigma1 = 0.2, sigma2 = 0.25,
  theta1 = 0.05, theta2 = 0.04
)

# Initial conditions
state <- c(
  C1 = 0.5,
  C2 = 0.5,
  Ra = 10,
  Rb = 10
)

# Time grid
times <- seq(0, 50, by = 0.1)

# Run simulation
out <- ode(y = state, times = times, func = model, parms = parms, method = "lsoda")
out <- as.data.frame(out)


# Plot
out_long <- out %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(C1, C2, Ra, Rb),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

ggplot(out_long, aes(x = time, y = Abundance, color = Variable)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Abundance",
    color = "Variable"
  ) +
 scale_color_manual(name = NULL,
                      values = c("C1" = "blue",
                                 "C2" = "red",
                                 "Ra" = "black",
                                 "Rb" = "grey")) +theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())

```
